description: Backend: complete the admin match EVENTS management and confirm/round out the LINEUP management. Events currently support GET/POST/DELETE only and a single PlayerName; extend the MatchEvent entity with nullable columns to properly describe substitutions and team side, add an UPDATE (PUT) endpoint, and add a versioned PostgreSQL migration. Lineup already has GET/PUT in AdminMatchDetailsController with audit; keep it and only adjust if needed for consistency. All admin routes stay under [Authorize(Roles="SuperAdmin,ClubAdmin,MatchManager")] and all writes are audited via AuditService. Public read contracts (GET /api/matches/{id}/events and /lineup) must remain backward compatible.
steps: In backend/src/JSO.Domain/Entities.cs, extend the MatchEvent class with two NULLABLE properties preserving existing ones: `public string? SecondaryPlayerName { get; set; }` (the incoming player for a substitution or the assist provider for a goal) and `public string? Team { get; set; }` (side of the event, expected values 'Home' or 'Away', nullable so existing rows stay valid). Keep Id, MatchId, Minute, Type, PlayerName, Notes exactly as they are.

In backend/src/JSO.Infrastructure/JsoDbContext.cs OnModelCreating, add a non-unique index on MatchEvents.MatchId: modelBuilder.Entity<MatchEvent>().HasIndex(x => x.MatchId); (mirrors the MatchOfficial index style). Do not change other mappings.

In backend/src/JSO.Api/Controllers/AdminMatchesController.cs: (a) extend the MatchEventRequest record to `public sealed record MatchEventRequest(int Minute, string Type, string? PlayerName, string? SecondaryPlayerName, string? Team, string? Notes);`. (b) In AddEvent, set matchEvent.SecondaryPlayerName = request.SecondaryPlayerName?.Trim() and matchEvent.Team = NormalizeTeam(request.Team) where NormalizeTeam maps null/empty to null and validates that a provided value is 'Home' or 'Away' (return BadRequest with a message if an invalid non-empty value is given). (c) Add a new endpoint [HttpPut("{id:guid}/events/{eventId:guid}")] UpdateEvent(Guid id, Guid eventId, MatchEventRequest request, CancellationToken ct): load the event scoped to the match (SingleOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == eventId && x.MatchId == id)); return NotFound if missing; apply the same validation as AddEvent (Minute 0..200, Type required, Team Home/Away-or-null); update Minute, Type, PlayerName, SecondaryPlayerName, Team, Notes; SaveChangesAsync; audit.LogAsync("UPDATE", "MatchEvent", eventId.ToString(), User.FindFirst("sub")?.Value, User.FindFirst("email")?.Value, HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString(), new { matchId = id }, ct); return Ok(matchEvent). Follow the exact audit call shape already used by AddEvent/DeleteEvent in this file.

Reuse the existing validation constants/messages style already in AddEvent (minute range message, event type required message). Keep the private team-normalization as a small local/private static helper in the controller.

Add a versioned PostgreSQL migration for the two new MatchEvent columns and the new index. Preferred: with dotnet-ef using the Postgres provider: Database__Provider=postgres /root/.dotnet10/dotnet ef migrations add ExtendMatchEvent --project backend/src/JSO.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/src/JSO.Api --context JsoDbContext -o Migrations/Postgres (install the tool if absent: /root/.dotnet10/dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef). If dotnet-ef cannot be installed/run in this environment, HAND-AUTHOR the migration file backend/src/JSO.Infrastructure/Migrations/Postgres/<timestamp>_ExtendMatchEvent.cs (+ .Designer.cs) matching the exact format of the existing 20260926144855_AddSponsor.cs: Up adds two nullable text columns (SecondaryPlayerName, Team) to MatchEvents via migrationBuilder.AddColumn<string>(type: "text", nullable: true) and creates index IX_MatchEvents_MatchId on MatchEvents(MatchId); Down drops the columns and index. Use a timestamp lexicographically AFTER 20260926144855.

Regenerate or hand-update backend/src/JSO.Infrastructure/Migrations/Postgres/JsoDbContextModelSnapshot.cs so the MatchEvent entity block includes the two new nullable string properties (HasColumnType("text")) and the new b.HasIndex("MatchId") on MatchEvents. Keep it consistent with the actual model; if generated by dotnet-ef this is automatic.

Do NOT change the public read controllers' response shape. MatchDetailsController.GetEvents and PublicMatchDetailsController.GetLineup return the entities/projections as-is; the added nullable fields append to the events payload without breaking existing consumers. Verify by reading those controllers that no explicit projection omits/renames fields in a way that breaks.
acceptance_criteria: MatchEvent has nullable SecondaryPlayerName and Team properties; existing fields unchanged.

A PUT /api/admin/matches/{id}/events/{eventId} endpoint exists, is covered by [Authorize(Roles="SuperAdmin,ClubAdmin,MatchManager")] (inherited from the controller), validates minute/type/team, updates the event, and writes an UPDATE audit log entry.
AddEvent persists SecondaryPlayerName and Team and validates Team is 'Home'/'Away'/null.
A new versioned PostgreSQL migration under Migrations/Postgres adds the two nullable columns and the IX_MatchEvents_MatchId index, and JsoDbContextModelSnapshot.cs matches the updated model.
GET /api/matches/{id}/events and GET /api/matches/{id}/lineup public contracts remain backward compatible (no removed/renamed fields).
/root/.dotnet10/dotnet build backend/src/JSO.Api/JSO.Api.csproj -c Release succeeds with 0 warnings and 0 errors.
verification: Confirm the build output shows 0 warnings / 0 errors (TreatWarningsAsErrors on).

Confirm the new migration file exists under backend/src/JSO.Infrastructure/Migrations/Postgres and that JsoDbContextModelSnapshot.cs references SecondaryPlayerName, Team, and the MatchId index for MatchEvents.
findings: Build gate '/root/.dotnet10/dotnet build backend/src/JSO.Api/JSO.Api.csproj -c Release' passed with 0 Warning(s) / 0 Error(s). Migration hand-authored (dotnet-ef tool could not run: it targets runtime 10.0.0-rc.2 while only 10.0.12 is installed, and JSO.Api does not reference Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design; adding that package was avoided to keep scope minimal). Migration filename: backend/src/JSO.Infrastructure/Migrations/Postgres/20260926150000_ExtendMatchEvent.cs (+ .Designer.cs), timestamp lexicographically after 20260926144855_AddSponsor. It adds nullable text columns SecondaryPlayerName and Team to MatchEvents and creates index IX_MatchEvents_MatchId; Down reverses both. JsoDbContextModelSnapshot.cs updated with the two new nullable string properties (HasColumnType text) and b.HasIndex("MatchId") on MatchEvents. AdminMatchesController: extended MatchEventRequest, AddEvent now persists SecondaryPlayerName/Team, new PUT {id}/events/{eventId} UpdateEvent with UPDATE audit, private TryNormalizeTeam helper validates Home/Away/null. Public read controllers (MatchDetailsController.GetEvents, PublicMatchDetailsController.GetLineup) unchanged and remain backward compatible (GetEvents returns the full entity so new fields just append).
